10/20/2008: Data Cleanup: 
 
            - Faulty 4" soil temperature sensor was replaced at 
              noon on Oct 09, 2008 (d=283).  It appears that the 
              sensor sstarted to fail at noon on Sep 08, 2008  
              (d=252).   
                
              All 4" soil temperature during the following time 
              period was marked as "missing": 
 
                  09/08/08 (d=252) 12:00 - 10/09/08 (d=283) 13:00

                                         B => CS616  
                                         C => Broadband Cell Modem (IP)
